name: flaggems__masked_scale
description: Extracted from FlagGems _masked_scale. Computes where(mask != 0, input * scale, 0). Only floating-point input is supported; tests/benchmarks use float32. mask is a uint8 tensor of 0/1 values; scale is a Python float. aten._masked_scale has no CPU backend, so the reference computes the result manually with torch.where (matching tests/test_masked_scale.py).
